name: Vishnu
info: Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe in Hindu tradition.
story: Vishnu is one of the principal deities of Hinduism and the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism.
visiting_guide: Temples are open early morning and evening. Dress modestly.
architecture: Dravidian and Nagara styles are common in Vishnu temples.

temples.name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
temples.about: One of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world, dedicated to Lord Venkateswara.

temples.name: Padmanabhaswamy Temple
temples.about: Ancient temple with Lord Vishnu in the Ananthasayana posture. One of the 108 Divya Desams.
temples.festivals: Alpashy Utsavam, Panguni Utsavam, Laksha Deepam

temples.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple Srirangam
temples.about: Largest functioning Hindu temple in the world. One of the 108 Divya Desams.

temples.name: Guruvayur Temple
temples.about: One of the most important Vishnu temples in Kerala, known as Bhuloka Vaikunta.

temples.name: Badrinath Temple
temples.about: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites, located in the Himalayas.
temples.festivals: Badri Kedar Festival, Mata Murti Ka Mela

name: Shiva
info: Lord Shiva is the destroyer and transformer in the Hindu Trinity.
story: Shiva is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, worshipped as the Supreme Being in Shaivism.
visiting_guide: Monday is considered auspicious for Shiva worship. Offer bilva leaves.
architecture: Shiva temples often feature a Shivalinga in the sanctum.

temples.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
temples.about: One of the most famous Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Shiva, one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.

temples.name: Somnath Temple
temples.about: First among the 12 Jyotirlingas, rebuilt multiple times after destruction.

temples.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
temples.about: Historic Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi and her consort Shiva.

temples.name: Kedarnath Temple
temples.about: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites and one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.

temples.name: Brihadeeswarar Temple
temples.about: UNESCO World Heritage Site, built by Raja Raja Chola I. A masterpiece of Dravidian architecture.

name: Devi
info: Devi is the supreme goddess in Shaktism, worshipped in many forms.
story: The Divine Mother is worshipped in various forms including Durga, Kali, Lakshmi, and Saraswati.
visiting_guide: Navaratri is the most auspicious time to visit Devi temples.
architecture: Shakti Peethas are important pilgrimage sites across India.

temples.name: Vaishno Devi Temple
temples.about: One of the most revered Hindu temples, located in the Trikuta Mountains.

temples.name: Kamakhya Temple
temples.about: One of the most important Shakti Peethas, located on Nilachal Hill.

temples.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
temples.about: One of the most visited temples in Mumbai, dedicated to Lord Ganesha.

temples.name: Shirdi Sai Baba Temple
temples.about: One of the most visited pilgrimage sites in India, dedicated to Sai Baba.

temples.name: Mahalaxmi Temple Kolhapur
temples.about: One of the six Shakti Peethas in Maharashtra, dedicated to Goddess Mahalaxmi.

name: Ganesha
info: Lord Ganesha is the remover of obstacles and the god of beginnings.
story: Ganesha is widely revered as the remover of obstacles, the patron of arts and sciences.
visiting_guide: Tuesday and Wednesday are auspicious for Ganesha worship.
architecture: Ganesha temples often feature the elephant-headed deity in the sanctum.

temples.name: Ashtavinayak Morgaon
temples.about: First of the eight Ashtavinayak temples, considered the most important.

temples.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple
temples.about: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas, located near the source of the Godavari river.

name: Rama
info: Lord Rama is the seventh avatar of Vishnu and the hero of the Ramayana.
story: Rama is the ideal man and perfect king in Hindu tradition.
visiting_guide: Ram Navami is the most auspicious time to visit Rama temples.
architecture: Rama temples often feature the deity with Sita, Lakshmana, and Hanuman.

temples.name: Ram Janmabhoomi Temple
temples.about: The birthplace of Lord Rama, one of the most sacred sites in Hinduism.

temples.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple
temples.about: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites and one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.

temples.name: Hanuman Garhi
temples.about: Important temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman in Ayodhya.

name: Krishna
info: Lord Krishna is the eighth avatar of Vishnu and the divine teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.
story: Krishna is one of the most widely revered deities in Hinduism.
visiting_guide: Janmashtami is the most auspicious time to visit Krishna temples.
architecture: Krishna temples often feature the deity with Radha or as a child.

temples.name: Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple
temples.about: The birthplace of Lord Krishna, one of the most sacred sites in Hinduism.

temples.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
temples.about: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites, the ancient kingdom of Lord Krishna.

temples.name: ISKCON Temple Vrindavan
temples.location: Bhaktivedanta Swami Marg, Vrindavan, Uttar Pradesh 281121
temples.about: Beautiful modern temple dedicated to Radha Krishna in the holy city of Vrindavan.

temples.name: Udupi Sri Krishna Temple
temples.about: Famous temple established by Sri Madhvacharya, known for the Kanakana Kindi window.

name: Surya
info: Surya is the solar deity and one of the Adityas in Hindu tradition.
story: Surya is the chief solar deity in Hinduism, worshipped as the source of light and life.
visiting_guide: Sunday is auspicious for Surya worship. Offer water to the rising sun.
architecture: Surya temples often face east to receive the first rays of the sun.

temples.name: Konark Sun Temple
temples.about: UNESCO World Heritage Site, a 13th-century Sun temple built in the shape of a chariot.

temples.name: Modhera Sun Temple
temples.about: 11th-century temple built by the Solanki dynasty, known for its intricate carvings.

name: Hanuman
info: Lord Hanuman is the devoted disciple of Lord Rama and the son of Vayu.
story: Hanuman is celebrated for his devotion to Rama and his extraordinary strength.
visiting_guide: Tuesday and Saturday are auspicious for Hanuman worship.
architecture: Hanuman temples often feature the deity in a standing or flying posture.

temples.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
temples.about: One of the most important Hanuman temples in Varanasi, established by Tulsidas.

temples.name: Salasar Balaji Temple
temples.about: Famous Hanuman temple in Rajasthan, visited by millions of devotees.
